links.outcome: DeepGrade grading performance on local retrospective slides against pathologist reference
links.effect: 100% specificity for low-grade tumours, 82.05% sensitivity for high-grade, AUC 0.914, agreement 86.79%, Kappa 0.71 (95% CI 0.51-0.90)
links.quote: The DeepGrade model reached a 100% specificity for low-grade tumours and an 82.05% sensitivity for high-grade tumours, with an AUC of 0.914 and an agreement level of 86.79%.

screen.reason: Retrospective external validation and comparison of an existing deep learning model (DeepGrade) for breast cancer histopathology grading against pathologists in an Ethiopian hospital setting.
